note: A SNAPSHOT OF THE LIVE CHAIN BEFORE THE "ARBITER CHAT KEY" CUT (10 August 2026).
This is NOT a derivation and not a rewind: it is what Base Sepolia answers to the
question "which selectors are mounted on the arbiter facet" in block 45281830 --
the last block BEFORE that cut's transaction (the first block with the new facet
0xEDE8B010... is 45281831; the boundary was found by binary search over the chain).
WHY. The bench of the 10 August cut used to obtain this layout by REWINDING the
census of 16 August by two steps (minus the eight selectors of the presentation
cut, minus three and plus one for the chat-key cut). The rewind is correct -- it
was cross-checked -- but it is a DERIVATION, and a derivation lives exactly until
the first error in the lists it is made from. The snapshot cuts the chain of
trust: the expectation is taken from the chain rather than computed here.
The rewind is NOT removed: it is checked against this file, and a divergence turns
the test red. One and the same number now has two independent sources instead of
